--- title: "Get a value in a specific cell of a polars dataframe" subtitle: "item" author: '{{< var author >}}' date: '2025-10-22' date-format: iso toc: true toc-title: 'Sections' toc-location: right toc-depth: 3 categories: [100DaysOfPolars] --- Polars allows you to target a dataframe down to a specific value, such as selecting a value from a particular cell in the table. Below is a dataframe showing streaming services. ::: {#64cb16d5 .cell execution_count=1} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ```{=html}
shape: (7, 2)
SubscriptionPrice
strf64
"Netflix"15.49
"Hulu"7.99

"Disney+"7.99
"AMC"8.99
``` ::: ::: ## Get specific value To get a specific value from the dataframe, such as "Disney+", use the `item` method like this: ::: {#64ff5035 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} (df .item(5,0) ) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 'Disney+' ``` ::: ::: ::: {.callout-note} The output value "Disney+" is a string that can be used in other Python code unrelated to Polars. This is not the same as running this code: ```python (df .filter(pl.col('Subscription') == 'Disney+') .select('Subscription') ) ``` ::: Learn more in my {{< var polars_course >}}!
